title: The Codebreaker's Caper
story: In a bustling tech hub, our detective finds himself on the trail of a coder extraordinaire who orchestrated a cyber heist. It began when tech mogul, Sarah Wilde, ace coder and owner of WildeTech, discovered a breach that resulted in the theft of her most confidential client data. This data, revealed to be from renowned AI start-up, CyberNexus, had been stolen by someone within her own tight-knit team. Our detective's task is to identify the culprit and recover the stolen data with the help of four suspects: Paul, Emily, John, and Lucas.
crimeScene: An extensive network of servers at WildeTech, with CyberNexus data traces
forensicClue: The presence of the AI-specific programming language, LuminScript, at the crime scene
question: Who is the mastermind behind the AI data theft? How did the detective solve the case?
options: Option D (Lucas and the forensic clue)
